source.description.zh-Hans: 迷雾漫画收录中文翻译的韩国条漫，另设 BL、GL、全年龄和英文专区。登录后可查看作品，部分作品的后记和番外也单独列章。
source.description.zh-Hant: 迷霧漫畫收錄中文翻譯的韓國條漫，另設 BL、GL、全年齡和英文專區。登入後可查看作品，部分作品的後記和番外也單獨列章。
source.description.en: MIWU Manga hosts Chinese-translated Korean webcomics, with BL, GL, all-ages, and English sections. Sign-in is required to view the catalogue, which also lists afterwords and side stories for some series.
